user.title: HAFAS Bus Monitor
user.description: Configure the first stop. Enter the city and a stop search term (for example "Kiel" and "Hospitalstraße"). Preferred lines are comma-separated; leave empty to show all lines. The walking time is used by the fastest-connection sensor.

select_stop.title: Select stop
select_stop.description: {count} possible stops found for "{query}". Select the correct stop.

add_stop.title: Add another stop?
add_stop.description: {count} stop(s) configured: {stops}. Add another stop to compare walking times for the fastest connection.

stop.title: Add stop
stop.description: Enter the city, search term and line filter for the additional stop.

error.cannot_connect: The HAFAS/NAH.SH service could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.no_stops: No stop was found for this search. Try a shorter or slightly different search term.
error.stop_required: A stop search term is required.
error.invalid_stop: The selected stop is invalid. Please try again.

abort.invalid_flow: The configuration flow is no longer valid. Please start again.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one HAFAS Bus Monitor entry is allowed. Add or edit stops in the existing entry.

settings.title: Polling and routing settings
settings.description: The update interval controls how often HAFAS is queried. The look-ahead window controls how far into the future departures are requested.

add_stop.title: Add stop
add_stop.description: Enter the city and stop search term, then select the correct HAFAS stop.

select_stop.title: Select stop
select_stop.description: {count} possible stops found for "{query}". Select the correct stop.

edit_stop.title: Edit stop
edit_stop.description: Select the stop whose line filter or walking time you want to change.

edit_stop_form.title: Edit {stop}
edit_stop_form.description: Change the line filter or walking time for this stop.

remove_stop.title: Remove stop
remove_stop.description: Select the stop to remove. At least one stop must remain.

error.cannot_connect: The HAFAS/NAH.SH service could not be reached. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.no_stops: No stop was found for this search. Try a shorter or slightly different search term.
error.stop_required: A stop search term is required.
error.invalid_stop: The selected stop is invalid. Please try again.

abort.invalid_flow: The configuration flow is no longer valid. Please start again.

refresh.name: Refresh departures
refresh.description: Fetch fresh HAFAS departure data for all configured stops immediately.
